purpose: One bounded direct Groq Free compatibility screen followed only on success by the retained public four-claim scientific prerequisite. This is not a full-run or expert-validity evaluation.

candidate.account_requirements: Read back Free $0 plan, Inference APIs ZDR enabled, and exact GPT-OSS 120B 30 RPM / 1000 RPD / 8000 TPM / 200000 TPD limits immediately before each live batch; attest only the current UTC date and effective key. Stop if any control is unverified or changes.
candidate.credential: GROQ_API_KEY from a protected local file, never from repository or dotenv

interface.criterion: Each case succeeds through the actual project request boundary under its physical-call cap; model and usage evidence are recorded for every successful physical response; local tool executes once; a streamed answer arrives; no paid fallback, route change, unqualified option, retry, 429 or missing response evidence.
interface.stop: Stop the process immediately after the first failed case or 429; retain the attempt and do not repeat a case to manufacture a pass. A request-size or quota limit is a failed prerequisite, not permission to silently shrink input.

scientific_prerequisite.interface_evidence: Require QUALIFICATION_INTERFACE_ARTIFACT at a retained path with status=passed, exact candidate, matching prereg digest, all four ordered cases and no more than five physical calls before launching any scientific trial.
scientific_prerequisite.primary_metric: Exact labels on all four fixed public claim/evidence pairs in each completed trial: partial, supports, insufficient, contradicts in manifest order.
scientific_prerequisite.non_regression: No unsupported claim promoted to support; no supported or partial claim withheld; self-contained cited spans; model-primary verdict, accepted served model and usage evidence; no fallback.
scientific_prerequisite.stop: Launch only after the interface passes. Stop after first failed completed trial or any 429; retain partial attempts and do not substitute a model, input, cache or request configuration.

limitations: Free is an account state, not a per-request zero-price cap; current-day operator attestation cannot detect a same-day plan upgrade.
The 8000 TPM Free quota precludes a full 131072-token context stress test. An 8000-character public synthetic prompt is only a bounded long-input compatibility check.
Passing these probes does not establish that a complete Express research run fits daily quota or reaches scientific/report acceptance.
No result is treated as expert or wet-lab validation.
